title: Embedding Adapter Config v0.1
description: Turn P4: provider/model identity for an EmbeddingAdapter, injected as configuration -- never hardcoded inside loader/retriever code (see embedding-adapter.mjs). Mirrors ../interfaces/model-config.schema.json's own shape and rules exactly, scoped to embeddings instead of chat completions. Turn P9.2 (additive, backward-compatible): added auth_mode/network_scope so a LOCAL loopback server can be called without a bearer key -- a config that never sets auth_mode behaves EXACTLY as before (api_key_env_var still required whenever kind=HTTP_EMBEDDINGS).

kind.description: Which generic adapter implementation to construct. FAKE_DETERMINISTIC never makes a network call. HTTP_EMBEDDINGS is a single generic HTTP embeddings-endpoint shape reused across providers; provider/model/endpoint stay fully config-driven, never branched on by name in code.

provider.description: Free-text provider label for telemetry/reporting only. Never used to select code paths.

model.description: Free-text embedding model name for telemetry/reporting only. Never hardcoded inside loader/retriever code.

revision.description: A provider/model revision label, pinned in reference_retrieval_indexes.embedding_revision so a later model version change is never silently mixed into the same index.

endpoint_url.description: Required when kind=HTTP_EMBEDDINGS; the full embeddings-endpoint URL.

api_key_env_var.description: Name of the environment variable holding the API key. The key value itself is never part of this config or of any telemetry/log output. Required when kind=HTTP_EMBEDDINGS UNLESS auth_mode is explicitly "NONE".

auth_mode.description: Turn P9.2. Absent means BEARER_ENV (the original, only-ever behavior -- fully backward compatible). NONE sends no Authorization header at all, and is only ever accepted by embedding-adapter.mjs's own runtime check for a LOOPBACK endpoint_url hostname (127.0.0.1/localhost/::1) -- an external hostname with auth_mode=NONE is refused before any request is sent, regardless of what this field claims.

network_scope.description: Turn P9.2. Optional, informational self-declaration for manifests/telemetry only -- embedding-adapter.mjs independently re-derives the real scope from endpoint_url's own hostname and never trusts this field for the auth_mode=NONE safety check.
